newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-NSW BEAT SOUTH AUSTRALIA IN SHEFFIELD SHIELD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NSW BEAT SOUTH AUSTRALIA IN SHEFFIELD SHIELD.

text.p: New South Wales beat South Australia by an innings and 169 runs on the final day of their four day Sheffield Shield match at the Sydney Cricket Ground on Sunday.
Scores: South Australia - 154 and 117 (Brad McNamara five for 19)
New South Wales - 440 for six declared (Michael Slater 102, Kevin Roberts 119, Greg Matthews 109 not out).
